title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Assistant Accountant

£30,000-£35,000 Full-Time Permanent Cambridge

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Assistant Accountant to join a growing finance team in a varied and hands-on role.

Working closely with senior finance leadership, you'll play a key role in supporting month-end processes, maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations.

This position would suit someone with previous finance experience who is looking to broaden their responsibilities and gain further exposure to management accounting and financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with the preparation of monthly management accounts.
- Maintaining purchase and sales ledgers.
- Performing balance sheet and ledger reconciliations.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving queries.
- Supporting payment runs and cash management activities.
- Managing company credit card and expense reconciliations.
- Preparing VAT returns and ensuring compliance with deadlines.
- Assisting with budgeting, forecasting and year-end processes.
- Producing financial reports and analysis as required.

About You
- Previous experience within an accounts or finance role.
- Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping.
- Experience with reconciliations and month-end activities.
- Good Excel skills.
- Experience using accounting software.
- Studying AAT or actively developing an accounting career would be advantageous.
- Organised, proactive and keen to learn.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000-£35,000.
- Full-time permanent position.
- Monday to Friday working pattern.
- Supportive team environment with opportunities for development.
- Exposure to a broad range of finance responsibilities.
- Pension scheme and generous holiday entitlement.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an Accounts Assistant or Assistant Accountant looking to take the next step in their career and gain wider exposure within a well-rounded finance function.

For more information, please apply or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Robert Half are delighted to be partnering with an established and highly regarded business based in Cambourne, Cambridge, to recruit a Credit Controller to join their finance team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys taking ownership of their ledger, building strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders, and playing a key role in improving cash collection and reducing outstanding debt.

Reporting into the Credit Control Manager, you will take responsibility for a designated portfolio of customers, working closely with operational teams across the business to ensure debts are managed effectively and queries are resolved promptly. The role offers a varied workload within a supportive and collaborative finance environment.

Responsibilities

As the Credit Controller, you will be responsible for:
- Managing and monitoring the collection of outstanding customer balances
- Working towards monthly cash collection targets
- Building effective relationships with customers and internal stakeholders
- Preparing and distributing aged debt reports
- Issuing customer statements and collection correspondence
- Managing accounts that require credit restrictions or "on stop" procedures
- Investigating and resolving queries that may be delaying payment
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date customer account records
- Processing daily cash receipts, allocations and monthly direct debit payments
- Supporting the setup of new customer accounts
- Supporting the Credit Control Manager with projects aimed at improving cash collection and overall credit control processes

Your Profile

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience working within Credit Control
- A proven track record of successfully collecting debt and delivering against targets
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload
- Good knowledge of Excel
- Previous experience using ERP/accounting systems, with IFS experience advantageous
- A proactive, professional and positive approach
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team
- A full UK driving licence

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £30 - £32,000
- Hybrid working (Three days in the office and two from home)
- Opportunity to join an established business
- Varied Credit Control position, with plenty of interaction across the wider organisation.
- Occasional travel to other locations across the UK.

For further information or to apply, please contact Robert Half.

Robert Half

- Maintain stock records, monitor levels and support the ordering, receipt and distribution of equipment and consumables.

- Assist with implementation tasks, record keeping, data checking, documentation and follow up activity as directed.
- Support colleagues with routine queries and help maintain clear implementation guidance and process notes

title: Medical Receptionist/ Administrator
description: Dr Laliwala and Partners are looking for an experienced or quick learner, enthusiastic and patient-focused Medical Receptionist/Administrator to join our friendly team at Nightingale Medical Centre. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the practice, providing excellent service to our patients and working closely with our clinical and administrative teams. We are looking for someone who is organised, flexible, a strong team player and able to work effectively in a busy GP practice environment. Previous experience within a GP practice or healthcare setting would be desirable. The Medical Receptionist/Administrator will provide an efficient and professional reception and administrative service to patients and the wider practice team. Main duties will include answering telephone calls, managing appointment requests, responding to patient enquiries, signposting patients to the appropriate service and processing online and electronic requests. The role will also involve updating patient records on SystmOne, processing registrations, data entry and supporting general administrative tasks. The successful candidate will work closely with clinical and non-clinical colleagues to ensure patients receive a helpful, efficient and high-quality service. Flexibility will be required to provide cover at our other practice sites when necessary. Job Description Medical Receptionist / Administrator The Medical Receptionist/Administrator will be responsible for providing a professional, efficient and welcoming service to patients, visitors and colleagues. The post holder will support the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and work closely with both clinical and non-clinical members of the team. The duties and responsibilities of the role will include: Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and professionally, dealing with patient enquiries appropriately and transferring calls when required. Process face-to-face, telephone and online/electronic requests from patients. Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system, booking, cancelling and amending appointments as appropriate. Signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional, service or source of support. Respond to enquiries and requests from patients, colleagues and external organisations in a professional and timely manner. Provide a welcoming and helpful reception service to patients and visitors attending the practice. Accurately update and maintain patient healthcare records using SystmOne. Read code information onto patient records where appropriate. Process new patient and temporary patient registrations and ensure relevant information is recorded accurately. Undertake general data entry and administrative duties as required. Process incoming correspondence and direct requests such as Subject Access Requests (SARs), insurance reports, solicitor requests and DVLA forms to the appropriate administrative team. Photocopy, scan and process documentation as required. Manage general patient and practice queries efficiently and appropriately. Support clinical and non-clinical colleagues with general administrative tasks as required. Maintain a clean, tidy and effective reception and working environment. Monitor and maintain the reception area and patient notice boards. Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with information governance and data protection requirements at all times. Follow practice policies, procedures and protocols and contribute to maintaining a safe working environment. Work collaboratively as part of the wider practice team and provide support and cover to colleagues when required. Attend practice meetings and undertake relevant training as required. Provide cover at other practice sites when required due to operational needs, staff absence or sickness. The post holder will be expected to demonstrate flexibility and undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role as required by the Practice Manager or Partners. This job description is intended as a guide to the main responsibilities of the post and may be reviewed and amended from time to time to reflect the changing needs of the practice.
